title: IncrementalClassificationLinear Fit
text: Fit incremental linear binary classification model, 4 inputs, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Prior data type} sets Data type of prior term; {Select initial machine learning model} sets the initial incremental linear classification model, {Add input port for observation weights} adds second input port for observation, {Add input port for resetting trained learner} adds input port for resetting trained incremental, {Predictor data observation dimension} sets the observation dimension of predictor data, {Sample time (–1 for inherited)} sets the option to specify sample, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the prevention of fixed-point tools from overriding data, {Beta data type} sets the data type of linear coefficient estimates, {Beta data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of beta for range checking, {Beta data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of beta for range checking, {Bias data type} sets the data type of intercept estimates Inherit, {Bias data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of bias for range checking, {Bias data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of bias for range checking, {Internal states data type} sets the data type of internal states Inherit, {Internal states data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of internal states for range checking, {Internal states data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of internal states for range checking, {Prior data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of prior term for range checking, {Prior data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of prior term for range checking, {Mu data type} sets the data type of predictor means Inherit, {Mu data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of mu for range checking, {Mu data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of mu for range checking, {Sigma data type} sets the data type of predictor standard deviations, {Sigma data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of sigma for range checking and {Sigma data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of sigma for range checking. Values come from the instance.
